issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case name `get_total_number_of_students()` while the UML, template comments, and the provided solution use the camelCase method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual method (total number of students) can confuse students about the exact identifier to implement in Java and may lead to compilation/test failures if they follow the snake_case form.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the problem statement with the Java/camelCase naming used elsewhere. Replace `get_total_number_of_students()` in the problem text with `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` (camelCase) to match the UML, template, and solution, and to follow Java naming conventions.
